body_html:
#smallpoems
#StopTheSteal

How does
blood of white privilege
dry when
ground
into
   sandstones stacked
by bloodied hands
  of American born
African chattle?

Do hues split into cracked
  and torn knuckles of
of forced laborers?

Shattered like families who
built
The People's House?
A
polychromatic dance
between Noah
  and Ham?

Or do the colors come together in a
Climate
united in a
stain on American
history?
